summary_text: In July 2026, three independent orders were placed, all occurring during the morning daypart on weekdays and weekends. The user consistently purchased fresh produce (Vegetables) and dairy staples (Milk, Curd Yogurt) across multiple dates. A single order included baby food (Baby Cereal), while another included ready meals and jaggery. No stable category combinations or daypart behaviors can be confirmed as durable preferences due to the low number of independent dates (3 total, but only 2 share the core Milk/Vegetables/Curd Yogurt pattern, and even that is limited to 2 dates). Abandonment patterns are not included in the stable list as no categories were abandoned across independent dates.
